rule: Each placed root reference and each method argument resolves only in the one realm named here: the placed roots, or an existing canonical realm selected whole by (realm file, realm pointer) at the pinned realm-file bytes. Literal original URIs and JSON pointers are unchanged; no namespace copy, alias reinterpretation, same-ID replacement, merged registry, caller-selected realm, host lookup or network fallback. Cross-realm continuation happens only through the explicit edges of original-reference-routing.json. A schema reference whose document URI is the $id of one of the 19 placed roots resolves only in placed_roots, whatever `realm` field encloses it in a method, tuple, participant or occurrence map. In such a position the map's `realm` value (native, coordinator, standard, event, current_d05_source, start_current_workflow_native_activation, combined_guard) records the realm name of the source declaration and selects no resolution realm; `combined_guard` is not a realm of this edition. A schema reference outside the placed roots resolves only in the realm that its method-root-bindings.json row or method_map_realm_field_bindings row names. An enclosing `realm` value there names that same selected realm, except the source realm name `start_current_goal_controls`, whose references are all bound to `goal`. Every placed-root map reference that method-root-bindings.json does not bind has one placed_root_map_references row (realm placed_roots). The realm field in scope is the one map_realm_fields names. Rows of native_v6 lineage occurrences bind the lineage combined declaration only; the registered argument binding of the same method is the row with a method_map. Realm rows whose pinned bytes are not at their path at the base are excluded and listed under rows_not_current_at_base; no binding reaches them.
